title: App keys can identify the apps behind them
summary:
App keys gained clearer attribution, Flux learned image-to-image, and six community projects joined the catalog.

Publishable keys gained App URL settings and a simpler App Key creation flow. Registered apps can show their name and developer GitHub link on the authorization screen while keeping the redirect hostname visible for verification. A new app-lookup endpoint resolves attribution from a verified app key or registered redirect URL.

`flux-2-dev` now accepts an image URL through the `image` parameter for image-to-image generation, alongside its existing text-only flow. The audio endpoint also routes `model=suno` to music generation instead of text-to-speech.

The catalog added a university question bank with AI explanations, PromptLab Studio, AI Image Gallery, AiApps, Fantasy Story Generator, and the Spix fitness companion. The projects span studying, making things, writing, organizing images, and tracking workouts.

daily.title: App keys with identity
daily.text: Register an App URL for a publishable key so your app name and developer GitHub link can appear on the authorization screen. The redirect hostname stays visible for verification. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

daily.title: Look up registered apps
daily.text: Use `GET /api/app-lookup` to resolve registered app attribution from a verified `app_key` or a redirect URL matching an App URL.

daily.title: Flux 2 Dev image input
daily.text: Pass an image URL through the `image` parameter to use `flux-2-dev` for image-to-image generation. Text-only prompts still work. [Explore flux-2-dev](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=flux-2-dev).
